# arXiv Intelligence MCP Server

Give your AI agent access to 2M+ arXiv preprint papers — search by keyword, author, or category; get paper details; profile authors; track citations and trending research.

## When to Call This MCP

Call arXiv Intelligence MCP when your AI agent needs to:
- Search academic preprints by keyword, author, or category
- Retrieve full paper metadata: title, abstract, authors, categories, dates
- Build author profiles with co-author networks
- Track forward citation chains for any arXiv paper
- Monitor trending papers by category week over week

## Tools

### search_papers

Search arXiv papers by keyword, author name, or category expression. Returns ranked results with title, abstract, authors, and categories.

Example AI prompt: "Find recent arXiv papers on diffusion models for code generation, sorted by relevance"

Parameters:
- query (required): Search query — keyword, author expression (au:"name"), or category expression (cat:cs.AI)
- maxResults (optional, default 10): Number of results to return
- sortBy (optional, default "relevance"): Sort by "relevance" or "lastUpdated"

### get_paper_details

Get full metadata for a specific arXiv paper by ID — abstract, all authors, categories, submission date, comments, journal reference, DOI, and links.

Example AI prompt: "Get the full details for arXiv paper 2301.00001 including abstract and author list"

Parameters:
- paperId (required): arXiv paper ID (e.g., "2301.00001" or "abs/2301.00001")

### get_author_profile

Get all recent papers by an author with their co-author network.

Example AI prompt: "Build a profile for Yoshua Bengio showing his recent papers and top co-authors"

Parameters:
- authorName (required): Full author name as shown on arXiv
- maxResults (optional, default 25): Maximum papers to return

### track_citations

Find papers that reference a given arXiv paper (backward) or papers that cite it (forward).

Example AI prompt: "Which papers cite the Transformer attention paper (1706.03762)?"

Parameters:
- paperId (required): arXiv paper ID to trace citations for
- citationType (optional, default "both"): "backward", "forward", or "both"
- maxResults (optional, default 20): Maximum results per direction

### get_trending_papers

Get the most recent papers from a specific arXiv category over the past week or month.

Example AI prompt: "What are the trending papers in cs.AI this week?"

Parameters:
- category (required): arXiv category (e.g., cs.AI, cs.LG, stat.ML, q-bio, q-fin)
- timeWindow (optional, default "week"): "week" or "month"
- maxResults (optional, default 25): Maximum results to return
